like.description: Limits for `like` anchors on Catalog Search.

max_items.description: Maximum anchors per request. When a request carries more, the Business processes the first `max_items` in request order and includes an informational `batch_limit_applied` message.

images.description: Inline image anchor support. Absent is equivalent to `max_items: 0`.

max_items.description: Maximum image anchors per request. Default 0: the Business accepts no image anchors until it advertises 1 or more, together with `types` and `max_bytes`. Image anchors count toward `like.max_items`.

max_bytes.description: Maximum length in bytes of one image anchor's base64 `data` string. Image bytes travel inside the JSON payload, so the limit applies to the encoded string.
